content.text: Register doesn't pass a provider, so the default in `UsersService.create` is used.

candidates.explanation: When createUserDto.provider is undefined, the provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then rejects them because user.provider !== AuthProvidersEnum.email, returning 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'. The default should be AuthProvidersEnum.email.
register does not set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly. It relies on the default in UsersService.create, which is wrong.

fix.description: Change the default provider in UsersService.create to AuthProvidersEnum.email. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
